snippet.title: Spice & Grill Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out Spice & Grill on Steam!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837270/Spice__Grill/

Welcome to Spice & Grill, a cozy restaurant that lives at the bottom of your screen. Build, decorate, and manage your own dining space, set up the best kitchen, and train the best chefs to serve customers all year round.

An indie game by DevSharks.
